description: Creates a new monitor in Uptime Kuma. Requires at minimum a name and type. Use listMonitorTypes to see supported types. For HTTP monitors include url; for TCP/port monitors include hostname and port; for json-query include url, jsonPath, jsonPathOperator and expectedValue. A push monitor is given a generated push token (Uptime Kuma only generates one in its own web UI) and the resulting ping URL is returned. timeout defaults to 0.8 x interval seconds for polled types.

active.description: Whether the monitor starts checking immediately (default: true). Pass false to create it paused.

description.description: Free-text description shown on the monitor page

dns_resolve_server.description: DNS server to use for resolution (required for dns type, default: 1.1.1.1)

dns_resolve_type.description: DNS record type to query (required for dns type, default: A)

docker_container.description: Docker container name (required for docker type)

docker_host.description: Docker host ID (required for docker type). Use listDockerHosts to find available IDs.

expectedValue.description: Threshold the json-query result is compared against. Stored as a string.

hostname.description: Hostname to monitor (required for port/ping/dns types)

jsonPath.description: JSONata expression for json-query monitors. Must resolve to a primitive.

jsonPathOperator.description: Comparison operator for json-query monitors. UP while value <operator> expectedValue.

json_path.description: Alias for jsonPath (the database column name). Prefer jsonPath.

keyword.description: Keyword to search for (keyword monitor type)

maxretries.description: Max retries before marking as down (default: 0)

method.description: HTTP method (GET, POST, etc.) for http type

notificationIDList.description: Map of notification IDs to enable (e.g. {"1": true, "3": true})

pushToken.description: Push token for push monitors — the secret in the ping URL. Omit and one is generated and returned.

push_token.description: Alias for pushToken (the database column name). Prefer pushToken.

resendInterval.description: Resend notification every N checks while down (0 = disabled, the default)

retryInterval.description: Retry interval in seconds when monitor is down (default: 60)

tags.description: Tags to assign to the monitor

timeout.description: Request timeout in SECONDS. Omit for 0.8 x interval. Avoid 0: Uptime Kuma's runtime fallback for a stored 0 computes interval * 1000 * 0.8 and then multiplies by 1000 again, yielding a ~13 hour timeout, so the monitor can never report DOWN against a host that accepts the connection and never answers.

type.description: Monitor type (e.g. http, port, ping, dns, push, keyword). Use listMonitorTypes for all options.

upsideDown.description: Invert status — treat up as down

url.description: URL to monitor (required for http/keyword/json-query types)

name: createMonitor

pushToken.description: Push monitors only. The token, so the sender can be wired up without a second, wider read.

pushURL.description: Push monitors only. The URL the sender should GET.

timeout.description: The timeout in seconds actually stored, including the default applied when omitted.

title: Create Monitor
